test_case: Phantom Brew whitebox flows › cart coupon applies a visible discount to the order total
estimated_root_cause: Add to Cart on /menu/1 did not update cart state; cart badge stayed 0 after click.
recommended_action: Investigate add-to-cart handler/state sync on product detail page before coupon assertions.

test_case: 注文ステータスページ › ステータスが「preparing」に進む
estimated_root_cause: Status progression is time/random-delay dependent and may remain 'received' within the fixed 5s window.
recommended_action: Poll until status changes with a longer timeout or control the backend timing in test.

test_case: 注文ステータスページ › 最終的にステータスが「completed」になる
estimated_root_cause: Checkout page/input '#customer-name' never became available, suggesting page load/app startup failure rather than status logic.
recommended_action: Check CI app startup/routing and ensure /checkout renders before filling form.

test_case: レート制限テスト › 通常のページ遷移でエラーが出ない
estimated_root_cause: Selector 'h1, .product-card' matches multiple elements, causing Playwright strict mode failure.
recommended_action: Use a single specific locator or assert on .first() / count instead of a multi-match union selector.
